combo.description: From longer range Q W then E yourself and instantly Flash and R. Maintain the tether while you AA and immediately use your W once it's back up.
When already in range R and instantly F Q W followed by AA's.
The typical Flash then instantly Q and use W as soon as you confirm Q will land.
Burst enemies with R then quickly Q W followed by AA's.
Lead with Q then W once you confirm it will land. Walk forward and E yourself then R once in range, then AA while maintaining the R tether. Use W as soon as it comes up and AA.
When close to an enemy R and maintain the tether then W AA right as it stuns. Use Q any time before the stun expires and continue to AA.
